objects.description: Opaque handle for the libnestegg demuxer stream context. It represents parser/state across the media file and owns track metadata, codec data, and packets it produces. Details of the struct are hidden from users.
Opaque handle for a demuxed packet containing one or more chunks belonging to a single track, with associated timing and encryption metadata. Memory is owned by the library until freed.

User-supplied I/O vtable passed to nestegg_init. Provides read/seek/tell callbacks and an opaque userdata pointer. The struct is passed by value into APIs; the callbacks must remain valid for the lifetime of the nestegg context.

Output container for video track parameters such as dimensions, stereo mode, color characteristics, mastering display metadata, and cropping. Filled by nestegg_track_video_params; the library does not own this memory.
Output container for audio track parameters including sample rate, channel count, bit depth, codec delay, and seek preroll. Filled by nestegg_track_audio_params; the library does not own this memory.

objects.definition: typedef void (* nestegg_log)(nestegg * context, unsigned int severity, char const * format, ...);
objects.description: Function pointer type for optional logging callbacks used by the library. The callback receives the context, a severity level, and a printf-style format with varargs.

functions.name: nestegg_init
functions.signature: int nestegg_init(nestegg ** context, nestegg_io io, nestegg_log callback, int64_t max_offset)
functions.description: Initialize a libnestegg demuxing context by scanning the input stream until the first media block, parsing tracks and metadata. Use the returned context for all subsequent API calls, and destroy it with nestegg_destroy when finished. Optionally provides a logging callback and a maximum readable offset.
requirements: context must be a valid pointer to receive the allocated nestegg* on success
io.read, io.seek, and io.tell callbacks must adhere to the specified return contracts and be usable for the lifetime of the context
io.userdata must be valid for all callback invocations
callback may be NULL; if non-NULL it must remain valid for the lifetime of the context
max_offset sets the maximum byte position read; set to -1 to ignore
Must check return value: 0 on success, -1 on error

functions.name: nestegg_destroy
functions.signature: void nestegg_destroy(nestegg * context)
functions.description: Destroy a nestegg context and free all associated resources. Call after finishing all operations on the context created by nestegg_init.
requirements: context must be a nestegg* previously returned by nestegg_init (or NULL-safe behavior is unknown)
After calling, the context must not be used again

data_types.description: Arbitrary bytes representing the beginning or entirety of a WebM or Matroska (MKV) media file. Expected to follow EBML-based container structure, including EBML header and segment elements. Suitable as an in-memory stream for demuxing/sniffing operations.

generators.generator:
import random
import struct
from typing import List, Tuple

# This script generates compact but valid EBML/WebM (Matroska) byte streams.
# It targets libnestegg sniffers and init by providing a minimal but parseable
# EBML header and a Segment with Info, Tracks, optional SeekHead/Cues, and a Cluster.
# Outputs are <= 4096 bytes and seeded.

# EBML helper functions

def ebml_vint_size(value: int) -> bytes:
    # Encode unsigned EBML VINT (data only). Choose minimal length (1..8 bytes).
    for length in range(1, 9):
        max_data = (1 << (7 * length)) - 1
        if value <= max_data:
            marker = 1 << (8 - length)
            total = value | (marker << (8 * length - 8))
            return total.to_bytes(length, 'big')
    raise ValueError("value too large for EBML vint")


def ebml_elem(elem_id: bytes, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    return elem_id + ebml_vint_size(len(payload)) + payload


def ebml_master(elem_id: bytes, children: List[bytes]) -> bytes:
    # children must be bytes; ensure proper type
    payload = b"".join(children)
    return ebml_elem(elem_id, payload)


def u8(v: int) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack('>B', v & 0xFF)


def u16(v: int) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack('>H', v & 0xFFFF)


def u32(v: int) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack('>I', v & 0xFFFFFFFF)


def u64(v: int) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack('>Q', v & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)


def ebml_uint(elem_id: bytes, value: int, size: int | None = None) -> bytes:
    # Unsigned integer element; choose minimal size (1..8) if not provided
    if size is None:
        size = 1
        while value >= (1 << (8 * size)) and size < 8:
            size += 1
    return ebml_elem(elem_id, int(value).to_bytes(size, 'big', signed=False))


def ebml_int(elem_id: bytes, value: int, size: int = 8) -> bytes:
    return ebml_elem(elem_id, int(value).to_bytes(size, 'big', signed=True))


def ebml_float(elem_id: bytes, value: float, size: int = 8) -> bytes:
    if size == 4:
        return ebml_elem(elem_id, struct.pack('>f', float(value)))
    return ebml_elem(elem_id, struct.pack('>d', float(value)))


def ebml_string(elem_id: bytes, s: str) -> bytes:
    return ebml_elem(elem_id, s.encode('ascii'))


def ebml_utf8(elem_id: bytes, s: str) -> bytes:
    return ebml_elem(elem_id, s.encode('utf-8'))

# EBML/Matroska IDs
EBML_ID = b"\x1A\x45\xDF\xA3"
SEGMENT_ID = b"\x18\x53\x80\x67"

# EBML header IDs
EBMLVersion = b"\x42\x86"
EBMLReadVersion = b"\x42\xF7"
EBMLMaxIDLength = b"\x42\xF2"
EBMLMaxSizeLength = b"\x42\xF3"
DocType = b"\x42\x82"
DocTypeVersion = b"\x42\x87"
DocTypeReadVersion = b"\x42\x85"

# Segment sub-elements
SeekHead_ID = b"\x11\x4D\x9B\x74"
Seek_ID = b"\x4D\xBB"
SeekID_ID = b"\x53\xAB"
SeekPosition_ID = b"\x53\xAC"
Info_ID = b"\x15\x49\xA9\x66"
TimecodeScale_ID = b"\x2A\xD7\xB1"
MuxingApp_ID = b"\x4D\x80"
WritingApp_ID = b"\x57\x41"
Duration_ID = b"\x44\x89"
Title_ID = b"\x7B\xA9"

Tracks_ID = b"\x16\x54\xAE\x6B"
TrackEntry_ID = b"\xAE"
TrackNumber_ID = b"\xD7"
TrackUID_ID = b"\x73\xC5"
TrackType_ID = b"\x83"
CodecID_ID = b"\x86"
CodecPrivate_ID = b"\x63\xA2"
DefaultDuration_ID = b"\x23\xE3\x83"
Name_ID = b"\x53\x6E"
Language_ID = b"\x22\xB5\x9C"

# Video
Video_ID = b"\xE0"
PixelWidth_ID = b"\xB0"
PixelHeight_ID = b"\xBA"
StereoMode_ID = b"\x53\xB8"
AlphaMode_ID = b"\x53\xC0"

# Audio
Audio_ID = b"\xE1"
SamplingFrequency_ID = b"\xB5"
Channels_ID = b"\x9F"
BitDepth_ID = b"\x62\x64"
CodecDelay_ID = b"\x56\xAA"
SeekPreRoll_ID = b"\x56\xBB"

# Clusters
Cluster_ID = b"\x1F\x43\xB6\x75"
Timecode_ID = b"\xE7"
SimpleBlock_ID = b"\xA3"
BlockGroup_ID = b"\xA0"
Block_ID = b"\xA1"
BlockDuration_ID = b"\x9B"
DiscardPadding_ID = b"\x75\xA2"
ReferenceBlock_ID = b"\xFB"

# Cues
Cues_ID = b"\x1C\x53\xBB\x6B"
CuePoint_ID = b"\xBB"
CueTime_ID = b"\xB3"
CueTrackPositions_ID = b"\xB7"
CueTrack_ID = b"\xF7"
CueClusterPosition_ID = b"\xF1"


def make_ebml_header(rnd: random.Random, as_webm: bool) -> bytes:
    elems = [
        ebml_uint(EBMLVersion, 1),
        ebml_uint(EBMLReadVersion, 1),
        ebml_uint(EBMLMaxIDLength, 4),
        ebml_uint(EBMLMaxSizeLength, 8),
        ebml_string(DocType, 'webm' if as_webm else 'matroska'),
        ebml_uint(DocTypeVersion, 4),
        ebml_uint(DocTypeReadVersion, 2),
    ]
    return ebml_master(EBML_ID, elems)


def codec_for_video(rnd: random.Random) -> Tuple[str, int, int]:
    codecs = [
        ('V_VP8', 320, 240),
        ('V_VP9', 640, 360),
        ('V_AV1', 640, 360),
    ]
    cid, w, h = rnd.choice(codecs)
    scale = rnd.choice([1, 2, 3])
    w = max(16, min(1920, w * scale))
    h = max(16, min(1080, h * scale))
    return cid, w, h


def codec_for_audio(rnd: random.Random) -> Tuple[str, float, int]:
    codecs = [
        ('A_OPUS', 48000.0, 2),
        ('A_VORBIS', 44100.0, 2),
        ('A_PCM/INT/LIT', 8000.0, 1),
    ]
    cid, rate, ch = rnd.choice(codecs)
    rate *= rnd.choice([1.0, 1.25, 0.5])
    rate = max(8000.0, min(192000.0, rate))
    ch = max(1, min(6, ch + rnd.choice([0, 0, 1, -1])))
    return cid, rate, ch


def make_tracks(rnd: random.Random, want_video: bool, want_audio: bool) -> Tuple[bytes, List[int]]:
    track_entries: List[bytes] = []
    track_numbers: List[int] = []
    tn = 1
    if want_video:
        cid, w, h = codec_for_video(rnd)
        ve = [
            ebml_uint(TrackNumber_ID, tn),
            ebml_uint(TrackUID_ID, rnd.getrandbits(32)),
            ebml_uint(TrackType_ID, 1),  # video
            ebml_string(CodecID_ID, cid),
            ebml_utf8(Name_ID, 'Video'),
            ebml_string(Language_ID, 'und'),
            ebml_master(Video_ID, [
                ebml_uint(PixelWidth_ID, w),
                ebml_uint(PixelHeight_ID, h),
                ebml_uint(AlphaMode_ID, 0),
            ]),
        ]
        if rnd.random() < 0.5:
            ve.append(ebml_uint(DefaultDuration_ID, rnd.choice([41666666, 33333333, 40000000])))
        track_entries.append(ebml_master(TrackEntry_ID, ve))
        track_numbers.append(tn)
        tn += 1
    if want_audio:
        cid, rate, ch = codec_for_audio(rnd)
        ae = [
            ebml_uint(TrackNumber_ID, tn),
            ebml_uint(TrackUID_ID, rnd.getrandbits(32)),
            ebml_uint(TrackType_ID, 2),  # audio
            ebml_string(CodecID_ID, cid),
            ebml_utf8(Name_ID, 'Audio'),
            ebml_string(Language_ID, 'und'),
            ebml_master(Audio_ID, [
                ebml_float(SamplingFrequency_ID, rate, 8),
                ebml_uint(Channels_ID, ch),
            ]),
        ]
        if cid == 'A_OPUS':
            ae.append(ebml_uint(CodecDelay_ID, 6500000))
            ae.append(ebml_uint(SeekPreRoll_ID, 80000000))
        track_entries.append(ebml_master(TrackEntry_ID, ae))
        track_numbers.append(tn)
        tn += 1
    return ebml_master(Tracks_ID, track_entries), track_numbers


def encode_simple_block(track: int, rel_timecode: int, keyframe: bool, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    # SimpleBlock payload: [TrackNumber VINT] [Timecode int16] [Flags u8] [Data]
    tn_vint = ebml_vint_size(track)
    flags = 0x80 if keyframe else 0x00
    block_payload = tn_vint + struct.pack('>h', rel_timecode) + u8(flags) + payload
    return ebml_elem(SimpleBlock_ID, block_payload)


def make_cluster(rnd: random.Random, timecode: int, track_numbers: List[int]) -> bytes:
    blocks: List[bytes] = [ebml_uint(Timecode_ID, timecode)]
    num_blocks = rnd.randint(1, 4)
    for i in range(num_blocks):
        tr = rnd.choice(track_numbers)
        key = (i == 0)
        size = rnd.randint(20, 80)
        if hasattr(rnd, 'randbytes'):
            payload = rnd.randbytes(size)
        else:
            payload = bytes([rnd.randrange(256) for _ in range(size)])
        rel = rnd.randint(0, 50)
        blocks.append(encode_simple_block(tr, rel, key, payload))
    return ebml_master(Cluster_ID, blocks)


def make_info(rnd: random.Random, timecode_scale_ns: int, duration_ns: float) -> bytes:
    elems: List[bytes] = [
        ebml_uint(TimecodeScale_ID, timecode_scale_ns),
        ebml_utf8(MuxingApp_ID, 'gen'),
        ebml_utf8(WritingApp_ID, 'gen'),
    ]
    if rnd.random() < 0.8:
        # Duration is stored in track time units (i.e., scaled), typically as float
        elems.append(ebml_float(Duration_ID, duration_ns / timecode_scale_ns, 8))
    if rnd.random() < 0.3:
        elems.append(ebml_utf8(Title_ID, 'Sample'))
    return ebml_master(Info_ID, elems)


def make_cues(first_cluster_offset: int, track_first: int, cluster_timecode: int) -> bytes:
    cue = ebml_master(CuePoint_ID, [
        ebml_uint(CueTime_ID, cluster_timecode),
        ebml_master(CueTrackPositions_ID, [
            ebml_uint(CueTrack_ID, track_first),
            ebml_uint(CueClusterPosition_ID, first_cluster_offset),
        ]),
    ])
    return ebml_master(Cues_ID, [cue])


def build_segment(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    timecode_scale = rnd.choice([1_000_000, 1_000_000, 1_000_000, 10_000_000])
    duration_ns = rnd.choice([3_000_000_000, 10_000_000_000, 60_000_000_000])
    info = make_info(rnd, timecode_scale, float(duration_ns))

    want_video = rnd.random() < 0.8
    want_audio = True if not want_video else (rnd.random() < 0.8)
    tracks, track_numbers = make_tracks(rnd, want_video, want_audio)

    include_cues = rnd.random() < 0.6
    include_seek = rnd.random() < 0.4

    # Build a temporary cluster to know its size; actual offsets only need the
    # offset of Cluster from start of Segment payload.
    cluster = make_cluster(rnd, 0, track_numbers)

    # Offsets from start of Segment payload
    off_seekhead = 0  # if present
    off_info = 0  # possibly after SeekHead

    # If we include SeekHead, it must be first; but it references positions
    # from the start of the Segment payload, so Info is after SeekHead.
    # We'll first compute sizes to place these.
    # Start with no SeekHead to compute base offsets for elements after it if present.
    base_payload_no_seek = b"".join([info, tracks])
    off_cues = len(info) + len(tracks) if include_cues else None
    off_cluster = len(base_payload_no_seek) + (len(ebml_master(Cues_ID, [])) if include_cues else 0)

    # Build real Cues using off_cluster
    cues = make_cues(off_cluster, track_numbers[0], 0) if include_cues else b""

    # Now possibly build a SeekHead that points to Info/Tracks/(Cues)
    seekhead = b""
    if include_seek:
        seeks: List[bytes] = []
        # If SeekHead is present, Info will be after it, so offsets still measured
        # from Segment payload start remain off_info= len(seekhead). To keep it simple
        # we place SeekHead at the start and still point to positions as if SeekHead
        # wasn't there? Matroska expects offsets from Segment payload start irrespective
        # of SeekHead size. So we use offsets without SeekHead included (Info at 0).
        off_info = 0
        off_tracks = len(info)
        seeks.append(ebml_master(Seek_ID, [
            ebml_elem(SeekID_ID, Info_ID),
            ebml_uint(SeekPosition_ID, off_info),
        ]))
        seeks.append(ebml_master(Seek_ID, [
            ebml_elem(SeekID_ID, Tracks_ID),
            ebml_uint(SeekPosition_ID, off_tracks),
        ]))
        if include_cues:
            seeks.append(ebml_master(Seek_ID, [
                ebml_elem(SeekID_ID, Cues_ID),
                ebml_uint(SeekPosition_ID, off_cues if off_cues is not None else 0),
            ]))
        seekhead = ebml_master(SeekHead_ID, seeks)

    segment_payload = b"".join([seekhead, info, tracks, cues, cluster])
    return ebml_master(SEGMENT_ID, [segment_payload])


def build_file(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    as_webm = rnd.random() < 0.8
    header = make_ebml_header(rnd, as_webm)
    segment = build_segment(rnd)
    data = header + segment
    if len(data) > 4096:
        # Build a tiny variant
        timecode_scale = 1_000_000
        info = make_info(rnd, timecode_scale, 1_000_000_000.0)
        tracks, tns = make_tracks(rnd, True, False)
        payload = b"\x00" * 16
        block = encode_simple_block(tns[0], 0, True, payload)
        cluster = ebml_master(Cluster_ID, [ebml_uint(Timecode_ID, 0), block])
        tiny_segment = ebml_master(SEGMENT_ID, [b"".join([info, tracks, cluster])])
        data = header + tiny_segment
    return data[:4096]


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    return build_file(rnd)
